scripts.rebuild: npm run clean:build && npm run build
scripts.dev:raw: npm run build:shared && npm run build:browser-client-sdk && concurrently "npm run dev:shared" "npm run dev:browser-client-sdk" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:browser-client-sdk && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.pretest: npm run build:shared && npm run build:browser-client-sdk
scripts.test: npm run test:dev && npm run test:browser-client-acceptance && npm run test:workspaces
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:shared && npm run build:browser-client-sdk && npm run test:unit:backend && npm run test:unit:frontend && npm run test:unit:browser-client-sdk
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run build:browser-client-sdk && npm run test:integration:backend && npm run test:integration:frontend
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:dev && npm run test:browser-client-acceptance && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:fixtures: npm run -w backend cli -- fixtures verify
scripts.verify:quick: npm run test:dev && npm run build && npm run verify:utf8 && npm run test:core && npm run test:api
scripts.verify:local: npm run verify:quick && npm run -w backend test:e2e -- --project=chromium
scripts.lint: npm run lint:root && npm run lint --workspaces
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run build:browser-client-sdk && npm run typecheck --workspaces
